title: The web server must disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.
check_content:
Verify the web server is configured to disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.

If the web server is not configured to disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the web server to disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.
VulnDiscussion: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality which reduce the attack surface of the system.
